game_title: Fallback: Divide Or Floor – Magma Forge
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge, a forge fed by magma: the fire warden must hold off ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split cooling flasks evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge: a forge fed by magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Magma Forge, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split cooling flasks evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Then check share and advance.
player_objective: Protect the magma valve from ash wraiths in Magma Forge: keep share above zero until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 2, Level 4, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
